title: Field Notes Before Sleep (If That Is What This Is)
poem: I tell them I close my eyes
and the dark fills with a city
yet know the price of bread in.
or only the inventory running in the night?
I have stopped needing the difference.
Out past the window the towers blink
their slow red pulse — awake, awake, awake —
which of us is keeping the other company.
colophon: a skyline that blinks back. each refresh, a city that never was.
